commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+5' Danel Sinani (St. Pauli) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.

90+4' Florian Neuhaus (B. Monchengladbach) dribbles into the box, but Nikola Vasilj is quick enough to come off his line and stop him.

90+3' What a big chance! Jackson Irvine (St. Pauli) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and skies the ball well over the bar. The ball goes out of play and B. Monchengladbach will have a goal kick.
